notes.title: Cublast HD | Version 1.1.0.5 | Ready for NEON?
notes.content:
Hello blasters!

The past few months we have been working on a big update. Cublast HD has been overhauled with a whole new neon style!

We have updated the game's levels, added a tutorial flow and you will now be able to add decals and change the colors of both players!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27679267/80a3287ade7095869eee1993666e295ca2356182.png[/img]

Check out the new trailer and screenshots on our [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/580590/Cublast_HD/]updated store page[/url].

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[code]- Graphics overhaul
- Upgraded customization system
- Added a tutorial
- New stage 8
- More controller support[/code]

Sadly these updates lead to a clean up of our save system which means progress had to be reset. (*Hotfix*) Luckily your high scores are still intact which means that we are able to automatically restore your progress from the online high scores on first launch!

Let us know what you think of this update through the official Cublast Facebook page, or as always in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/580590/discussions]Discussions[/url] area of the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/580590]Community Hub[/url].

Enjoy the update!

notes.title: Cublast HD | Update 1.3.817
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27679267/2623b67d8c5eafccd65bcf129d906fb64e656be6.png[/img]

What's up Blasters,

Today we are releasing a new update, containing multiple bug fixes and improvements for co-op & versus gameplay. Sadly this meant that we had to delay the release of our new stages.

We have chosen to delay the release of the stages to focus on fixing bugs. Of course we want to ensure the quality of our product, that means that we don't want to rush our content that is put out. The release date of the single player, co-op and versus stages will be postponed for one week. This week we will release a stage for both co-op & versus and next week there will be a new stage for single player to look out for!

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
 [*] Co-op and Versus fixes & improvements.
[list]
     [*] Added a respawn delay in versus.
     [*] Fixed players not dying in replays.
     [*] Fixed reversing deaths and finish in replays.
[/list]
 [*] The game now launches in native resolution instead of 1024*768
 [*] Fixed a bug where players were able to enter the finish cube from its underside.
 [*] Updated release dates of new stages.
[/list]

As always, please continue to post your bug reports and feedback in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/580590/discussions/] Discussions [/url]area of the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/580590] Community Hub[/url].

notes.title: Cublast HD | Update to Version 1.3.787
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27679267/2623b67d8c5eafccd65bcf129d906fb64e656be6.png[/img]

What's up Blasters,

Here's an update to fix a few little issues with the navigation and as always we've improved some bug fixes all listed below.
[list]
 [*] Highscore Tabs: When quick switching between tabs, it didn't always load the right tab.
 [*] Added a Upload Button: Due to confusing in uploading levels to the community, we've added a button in the main level editor menu. Uploading can now be done through that button or through Community > My Profile.
 [*] Fixed Sound Bug Physics Cube: When the player pushed around a Physics Block while being upside down, the pushing sound would loop and repeat itself.
 [*] Fixed Achievements: Some achievements weren't displayed correctly in the Steam Achievements menu.
 [*] Miscelanousimnsssss Bug Fixes
[/list]

As always, please continue to post your bug reports and feedback in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/580590/discussions/] Discussions [/url]area of the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/580590] Community Hub[/url].
